Harry Packman is a member of The Life Lutheran Church in Old Westbury, NY. He served as their first President and drafted their By-laws and Constitution. He recently returned to their Council and is now Chairing their Missions Committee. He is also the Chairman of Team Joseph, a not-for-profit organization based in Michigan. Team Joseph raises money to fund research seeking a cure for Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy as well as funds to assist families with children afflicted with Duchenne’s.
